## About
Prime Complete Auto Services is a collision and repair shop on E Artesia Blvd in North Long Beach. We handle cosmetic and structural repair, paint, dents, glass and mechanical work, and we try to make the whole process as hassle-free as we can.
We keep our pricing transparent, help you through your insurance claim, and send you updates while your car is with us. Our workmanship is covered for as long as you own the vehicle.
Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating on Google across 30 reviews. Stop by or give us a call and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Collision repair: Cosmetic and structural repair after an accident, including bumper and paint work.
- Insurance help: We work with your insurance company, talk with your provider, and make sure the repairs are documented the way they need.
- Paintless dent removal: Minor dents and dings removed without touching the original paint finish.
- Windshield and glass replacement: We remove damaged glass, clean the area and install new glass to manufacturer's standards.
- Mechanical repair: Diagnosis, maintenance and repair for your engine, transmission, suspension, brakes and electrical system.
- Vehicle transport: If your car can't be driven, we can bring it to our shop for repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help the repair process go smoothly.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on how much damage there is, which repairs are needed, and how quickly parts come in. We'll keep you updated while your car is here.

Q: Do you offer a warranty on your repairs?
A: Yes. Our workmanship is covered for as long as you own the vehicle, and parts carry the manufacturer's warranty. If something isn't right, bring it back and we'll fix it.

Q: When are you open on the weekend?
A: Saturday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
